label: EXPLORATORY_DIRECTIONAL_REANALYSIS
question: Does a fixed B2 mechanism score carry signed-return information beyond B0+B1 after horizon and time-of-day controls?

instrument.name: equal_weight_three_feature_directional_score
instrument.orientation_source: frozen 2026-08-18 Ext1 same-sign coefficients in D and V
instrument.preprocessing: registry transform, median, mean, and scale fitted on all D rows without outcomes; missing values contribute zero after imputation
instrument.interpretation: positive score predicts positive signed return

native_tod.sample: all rows with the requested horizon

matched120_no_tod.sample: rows with signed_return_120, identical at every horizon

matched120_tod.sample: rows with signed_return_120, identical at every horizon

family.adjustment: Holm across every two-sided primary p-value
family.directional_metric_scope: matched120_tod, horizons 60 and 120, all four cells

decision_rule.pursue: V_all matched120_tod h60 and h120 must each have theta > 0, ci_95_low > 0, Holm p <= 0.05, and absolute theta >= familywise MDE; native_tod h60 and h120 must have the same positive sign
decision_rule.operational_falsifier: Any pursue condition fails: the directional lead is not established strongly enough to justify a new program

legacy_reproduction.comparison_rule: Run the current corrected estimator on the same bar-source universe and report every design, input, row, and numerical difference; do not call it exact when the frozen artifact lacks input hashes

historical_decay_comparator.use: historical context only; never a numerical acceptance benchmark
